Task ID
IMP-28

Title
Connect PCR and APQP launches, dates and outcomes

Category
Originating application connection

Objective
Keep PPAP linked to its originating work without overwriting concurrent approvals or completing cancelled work.

Detailed scope
Configure PPAP-side MOC Proceed to PPAP and APQP launch/outcome adapters, including the verified task pointer/date handlers. Use complete source validation and one launch result per origin decision token; resolve multiple linked PPAP obligations explicitly.

Deliverable
Origin launch, authorized date/owner synchronization and successful/cancelled outcome connections.

Work needed first
IMP-03 — Set up PPAP scope and the integrated part warrant
IMP-04 — Set up PPAP issue and approval facts
IMP-11 — Set up model schedules and physical build events
IMP-17 — Resolve SIA and supplier responsibility and eligibility
IMP-18 — Create internal target PPAP drafts

What the earlier tasks provide
• IMP-03 provides the PPAP facility/drawing/part/warrant fields and target due/display settings.
• IMP-04 provides the issue, review, replacement, cancellation and frozen approval/output fields.
• IMP-11 provides the model/date/build-event fields and PPAP schedule links.
• IMP-17 provides the exact-entity role/capability checks and eligible assignment operation.
• IMP-18 provides the repeat-safe internal target Draft creation operation.

What is waiting
Waiting: the native source actions, outcome destination and multiple-PPAP obligation rule are needed before the executable connection can be configured.

Recommended implementer role
Senior Consultant

Recommended reviewer/approver role
Senior Consultant — PPAP build reviewer (a different person)

Why this role is recommended
This work changes several related records or decisions. A Senior Consultant should configure its order and recovery behavior because an incomplete update could change approval history or expose the wrong work.

Changes to the existing setup
Set RelatedPPAP on Task (891eff41-8aa1-44b2-83ab-aa3258126fae; /GraphData/Items/756)
The package writes the separate singular RelatedPPAP pointer when PPAP is created. For target records leave it untouched and use existing PPAP.Task with its Task.PPAPs related collection; do not overwrite a concurrent source obligation.

Update Integrated Task Due Date (19fa8394-fd01-4057-a7bb-8780d5b67b7d; /GraphData/Items/502)
The package writes PPAP due date to linked Task without target scope checks. Replace only its target branch with an explicitly authorized scoped date update; preserve issued PPAP baseline, completed/closed history and native reason evidence.

Update Related PPAP Project Owner and Due Date (4b1cb894-4720-4ba0-b469-dafbf4913664; /GraphData/Items/245)
The package pushes task owner/date through singular RelatedPPAP. Bypass that shortcut for target work; permitted explicit scoped reassignment/date updates must use current eligible SIA engineer and open-work rules and cannot overwrite management-stage responsibility.

Auto Close Related Task WF (b4b01894-d81c-41cf-be14-ba9f519ea0af; /GraphData/Items/954)
The package treats Completed or Cancelled PPAP as task fulfilment and sets completion/not-required values. For target records accept successful fulfilment only from actual Approved, after the originating obligation scope is satisfied. A single explicitly bound obligation may complete; several linked PPAPs require supplied scope-aware resolution. Cancelled only queues owner resolution and cannot set Task.IsCompleted or DateNotRequired as success.

Build instructions
1. Configure the proposed PPAP Origin Connection for MOC SQA Proceed to PPAP and authorized APQP launch. Pass exact source/facility/drawing/parts/change type, decision token and origin reference to Create Target PPAP Draft; preserve one returned Draft per decision token and intended scope. A process change may use existing released drawing context.
2. Preserve Originating PCR and existing PPAP.Task links; do not create a second supplier request/PCR lifecycle or authorize shipment. Keep legacy/APQP-only handler branches unchanged while applying the specified target task-pointer/date differences.
3. Provide a native durable Record PPAP Outcome operation called by approval/cancellation before their terminal commit, and a delivery operation retried after commit. Successful/cancelled outcomes include PPAP identity, source, facility/drawing/parts and actual outcome, with no fabricated resolution field.
4. Complete a single bound task obligation only after its explicit scope-aware Approved result. Where several PPAPs link one task, expose their individual outcomes for the supplied originating obligation rule/owner resolution; never close on first success or a latest-pointer shortcut. Cancellation never closes the whole originating process.

How to check the result
• Two PPAPs can link one Task without overwriting singular RelatedPPAP; date/owner updates cannot alter unrelated/closed packages.
• Replaying a PCR Proceed decision returns one internal process-change Draft and does not authorize shipment.
• Cancelled target PPAP does not mark originating work completed or not required.

Information needed for this task
IN-08: Supply PCR/APQP launch actions/tokens/fields, owner-resolution destination and multiple-obligation rules. These concrete interfaces cannot be guessed from a singular task pointer.
IN-03: Supply typed target-branch access for the existing task/PPAP shared handlers.
IN-04: Supply native durable outcome/replay methods for creating once and retrying delivery without replaying approval/cancellation.

Supplied input context
• IN-08 — PCR and APQP launch and outcome connections: The PCR/APQP owners must supply the Proceed to PPAP decision token and fields, authorized launch/callback actions, originating owner-resolution destination, and the rule for obligations served by multiple linked PPAPs. Target launch and successful/cancelled outcomes wait for those connections; no new MOC/PCR lifecycle is assigned.
• IN-03 — Supported target workflow and shared-handler connection: The technical team must supply the supported way to select a new PPAP-only workflow for target records, read the PPAP-only Target Configuration? field from shared handlers, set it before legacy handlers run, and resolve the direct/inherited Id name collision. The plan assigns the resulting configuration changes, not a tenant-verification exercise.
• IN-04 — Supported complete-save, copy and recovery methods: The technical team must supply the supported native methods for saving related records/files together, preventing conflicting simultaneous changes, retaining action/audit reasons, reopening an approved element without losing history, and durably resuming failed publication/submission/cancellation/outcome delivery. Only the consuming operations wait; no processing-permission or custom audit subsystem is requested.

Specification references
• [Target PPAP technical specification](ppap-target-technical-specification.md)
• [Canonical target field contract](ppap-target-field-contract.md)

Assumptions and open questions
New operational PPAPs only. SIA PPAP Engineer means an internal SIA user; supplier personnel act through their separate supplier roles.

2. Before submission validate every required matching typed answer, minimum/allowed files and native upload limits. A zero/ FALSE answer is complete when that typed question permits it. Validate applicable current inspection/result/version references and copy any required immutable artifact. A rejected incomplete attempt creates no first-submission performance event.
3. Lock the element and allocate Sequence=next integer for that Element with unique Element+Sequence. Create Evidence Snapshot.Element and copy Submission Comment, Working Files bytes/native file metadata, exact typed answers/Question Versions and current result/specification version evidence. 5. Save the complete submission before entering Engineer Review, then publish its engineer-review event. Use action correlation to return the same successful snapshot on retry. File/answer failure leaves Work In Progress with no partial current submission and no false first-event stamp.

Model schedule/event forms and PPAP model-connection controls.

Senior Associate Consultant

Recommended reviewer/approver role
Senior Consultant — PPAP build reviewer (a different person)

Why this role is recommended
The assignment combines established field, related-list and form settings. A Senior Associate Consultant can apply the conditions consistently, with the separate build reviewer checking their effect on the wider process.

Fields and features to set up
PPAP Model Change.Code
Set the type to Text; up to 100 characters. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: None. Who can use it and when: Designated model lead; fixed after first related PPAP Issue. Field/control lifecycle: Unique model/program code; not ECS number.

Create a link to PPAP Model Change, selecting zero or one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Enable the reverse read-only list PPAP Model Change.PPAPs. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: SIA PPAP Engineer in Draft; required when Model Change populated; hidden and NULL when no Model Change; new selection filters Active?=TRUE; preserve existing inactive references read only. Field/control lifecycle: Draft context clearing clears stage after warning; issued context locked.

Set the type to Yes/No (Boolean). Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: TRUE when Model Change selected; FALSE otherwise. Who can use it and when: SIA PPAP Engineer may Disconnect/Reconnect while open with warning and reason; FALSE forced if Model Change NULL. Field/control lifecycle: Schedule recalculation handler operates only when TRUE; manual dates persist disconnected.

PPAP Model Change.PPAPs
Create a read-only related-record list over PPAP.Model Change; one owning record can show many linked entries (inverse 1:M). Store no second link. Optional navigation only. Apply the owning-record and file permissions; make the list read only and populate it only through the declaring link, with no separate stored value.

PPAP Model Change.Dates
Create a read-only related-record list over PPAP Model Date.Model Change; one owning record can show many linked entries (inverse 1:M). Store no second link. Optional navigation only. Apply the owning-record and file permissions; make the list read only and populate it only through the declaring link, with no separate stored value.

Create a read-only related-record list over PPAP Build Event.Model Change; one owning record can show many linked entries (inverse 1:M). Store no second link. Optional navigation only. Apply the owning-record and file permissions; make the list read only and populate it only through the declaring link, with no separate stored value.

1. Configure one Model Date per Model Change+Phase+Manufacturing Stage. Require a reason when Planned Date changes. Give the designated Model Lead/schedule administrator ordinary date maintenance; the shared security assignment provides record grants.
2. Configure physical Build Event Start Date and End Date as inclusive dates; require Start Date<=End Date, with equal values for a same-day event. Do not use a build event as a phase-matrix cell.
3. Require Model Change when PPAP Type.Code=NEW_MODEL and Manufacturing Stage whenever Model Change is populated. If no Model Change, keep stage NULL/hidden and force Schedule Connected?=FALSE. In Draft, clearing model context warns and clears related stage/connection together; issued context is locked.

• Duplicate model/phase/stage cells and an event ending before it starts are rejected.
• A NEW_MODEL PPAP cannot be prepared without one model/stage; running/process changes may retain independent dates.
